title: Average cost as seed expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet with probability distribution $\\pi$, let $\\alpha$ be an output set, and let $f:\\Omega^n\\to\\alpha$. For any randomized decision tree $T$ computing $f$, its average query cost under independent inputs drawn from $\\pi$ equals the expectation, over the random seed of $T$, of the selected deterministic tree's average query cost under that same input distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $\\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\\Omega$
$T$ is a randomized decision tree computing $f$
